    GLM price performance

    Over the past year, Golem has fallen 54.8%. Its daily closes ranged from $0.0861 (November 20, 2026) to $0.3325 (January 13, 2026) over the last 52 weeks. On November 22, 2026 it closed at $0.0883, 73.4% below that high, with 30-day annualized volatility of 72.2%. Its best full month was Nov 2025 (+33.46%) and its worst was Feb 2026 (-35.20%). Over the last 90 days its daily moves had a correlation of 0.63 with Bitcoin's (closely tied; 1 would mean moving in lockstep). Its largest fall between daily closes within the year was 74.1%, from January 13, 2026 to November 20, 2026. Over one year it ranked 5th of the 14 DePIN coins tracked here with a full year of data.

    About Golem

    Golem is a decentralized marketplace for computing power on Ethereum, where providers rent out spare CPU and GPU capacity for GLM.
